 Motorola Razr Fold finally receives Android 17 stable update
 Post your comment 
 Comments (9) 
 Sagar 
 19 November 2026 
 Motorola Android Firmware Updates 
 Motorola rolled out the stable Android 17 update to some of its folding and non-folding smartphones, but it left users of its most expensive folding smartphone, the Razr Fold , waiting. Well, the wait is finally over, as Motorola has released the stable Android 17 update for the Razr Fold.
 Motorola Razr Fold

 Motorola hasn't made an official announcement about Android 17's rollout for the Razr Fold, but multiple Reddit users reported receiving it. The update has firmware version A171WB.27-36-2 and requires a 4.15GB download.
 Here's what the update's changelog says:
 Enjoy a fresh, expressive design
 Reduce clutter with smarter notifications
 Multitask faster and keep more apps accessible at once
 Stay extra secure with enhanced protection and controls
 You can head here to learn more about what Android 17 brings to Motorola smartphones .
 In addition to new features and improvements, the Android 17 update for the Razr Fold fixes a bug that caused adaptation issues with Telegram and some other apps.
 The update is currently seeding in Europe ( Hungary and Spain , specifically) to non-beta users, but the rollout should expand to other regions soon.
 If you live in a different country and received Android 17 on your Razr Fold, let us know in the comments below.
